notes: Arrivals are random; everything else is the controller's response to them.
Speeds on the simulation backend are modelled from occupancy and free-flow speed. They are not measured by the tracker in app/sensors/speed.py, which needs a camera.

The delay reduction here is usually larger than the figure in scripts/benchmark.py, and should not be quoted in its place. Demand is randomised, so some days are oversaturated, and a fixed-time plan degrades much faster than an actuated one once demand exceeds capacity. benchmark.py holds demand fixed at a level both controllers can serve, which is the fair comparison.
Detector rows with degraded=true correspond to a station that publishes nothing at all in iot_messages.jsonl. The silence is the fault signal.
